commands.command:
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
OUT=/var/lib/inventory/inventory.log
while true; do
  printf '%s host=%s uptime=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$(hostname)" "$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)" >> "$OUT"
  sleep 10
done
EOF

commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

# Sandboxing
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
StateDirectory=inventory
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM
UMask=0027

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
